description: Ingest a catalog of Sigma workbooks + their elements (via GET /v2/workbooks and GET /v2/workbooks/{id}/elements) and return a pandas DataFrame, one row per (workbook, element). Identifies Input Table elements via type == 'input-table' (Sigma's own documented approach). Surfaces workbook-level createdBy/updatedBy/timestamps/latestVersion as the closest API-exposed audit proxy -- true per-row Input Table audit history is a Sigma UI-only feature not exposed via the public REST API.

outputs.description: DataFrame of Sigma workbook + element records, one row per (workbook, element)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the SigmaResource this asset depends on for authentication

workbook_limit.label: Workbook Limit
workbook_limit.description: Maximum number of workbooks to catalog across all pages

page_limit.label: Page Limit
page_limit.description: Page size for both the workbooks and elements list calls (Sigma caps limit at 1,000).

include_elements.label: Include Elements
include_elements.description: Fetch each workbook's elements (one extra paginated call per workbook). If false, emit one row per workbook only.

input_tables_only.label: Input Tables Only
input_tables_only.description: Only meaningful when include_elements=true. Keep only type=='input-table' elements, dropping workbooks with none entirely.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics-eng) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['sigma', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None for unpartitioned. Sigma's List Workbooks API has no time-range filter, so a time-based type only controls run cadence.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Sigma Workbook Ingestion
